task_card.title: Bench FLUX.2 Klein 9B: base vs turbo LoRA vs distilled vs KV - pick the shipped weight

next_action.description: Move MPI-600 todo -> doing (it needs checklist.md + files.json), start the standalone bench on port 8188, load research/klein_9b_bench.json and run Leg 0: one 1024x1024 edit on flux-2-klein-9b-int8-convrot + qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot, recording peak VRAM. Read research/README.md first - it holds every node id and the 4B-LoRA trap.

key_decisions: INT8 ConvRot for everything, decided by Fabio - fp8 only as a fallback if 9B INT8 fails where five other models do not.
Reuse the shipped Klein 4B template rather than author a new graph (Fabio). The copy is research/klein_9b_bench.json.
bf16 is off the bench entirely - ~29GB against a 16380 MiB RTX 4060 Ti, and not a format we would ship.
Do not bench on a rented 5090; a 5090 number describes a card our users do not have.
Klein 4B is out of scope as a control - different model, different licence, already shipped.
constraints: EVERY LoRA baked into klein_t2i.json is a 4B LoRA, and LoraLoaderModelOnly loads the file even at strength 0. Node 38 (NSFW) is unconditional in the model chain - already bypassed in the bench copy, but never re-enable it on a 9B arm.

Input_is_Turbo (node 52) drives NUMBERS ONLY - steps/cfg/negative-conditioning. There is no turbo-LoRA loader node. The turbo LoRA rides Input_Lora_1 (node 99), which is a free MpiLoraModel slot already in the model chain.

The turbo LoRA is the DISTILLATION DELTA (Klein-distilled minus Klein-base, LoRA-decomposed), so strength is a continuous base-to-distilled dial and 'base+turbo@1.0 = distilled' is the premise, not a finding. Leg A sweeps strength rather than toggling.
KV only helps ops carrying a REFERENCE image - t2i gains nothing. BFL's 2.5x is 4 refs at 512; single-ref at 1024 is 1.40x, so record ref count and output resolution on every KV row.
No Qwen3-8B dependency exists and none can be promoted - qwen3-4b-clip is a different size, boogu-qwen3vl-8b-clip is a vision-language model at type 'boogu'. MPI-598 owes a brand-new ~9.4GB dep.
Outputs go to D:\WORK\Images\Outputs\klein_9b, sub-foldered per arm. The bench's SaveImage prefix is relative to D:\WORK\Images\Outputs, NOT <ComfyUI>\output.
Timing traps: execution_cached makes same-seed+same-graph wall clocks a lie; run 1 after a weight swap is not warm; confirm the resolution per series.
The board is co-owned right now - peer sessions are live on MPI-567, MPI-573 and MPI-599. board.json and events.jsonl need the build-the-blob recipe in .claude/rules/git.md, not `git commit --only`.
